subject: StrikeZone strategic onboarding: discount & packaging clearance
messages:
From: Sam Price <sam.price@strikezone.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro — Redwood eval follow-up

Thanks for the demo today — Lauren and I are aligned internally and ready to move to an initial production pilot. High level ask: can Redwood support a 12-month onboarding package scoped to 10M generated tokens/month with a 40% discount to list for the first year? We need predictable unit economics to make the case to our board. Also would like two additional seats for our data engineering team bundled in.

Couple constraints from our side: SOC2 attestation timeline is tight (we can accept a Private deployment delay), and procurement needs a single SOW referencing a fixed monthly invoice.

Attachments: strikezone_notes.pdf (stub)

—Sam
Head of Platform, StrikeZone
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Price <sam.price@strikezone.ai>, Lauren Chen <lauren.chen@strikezone.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:27:00 -0800
Subject: StrikeZone strategic onboarding: clearance request (40% off, bundled seats)

Team — moving to you for formal review and (if appropriate) VP/CFO clearance. Quick summary:

- Account: StrikeZone (Series B, health-tech analytics)
- Proposed first-year package: 10M tokens/month, 40% discount to standard hosted list, 2 added seats (no extra per-seat fee during year 1), 12-month term
- Commercial rationale: long-term potential (they expect to expand to ~60M tokens/mo in year 2), strong reference value in our vertical, willing to sign a 12-month committed invoice and provide a short case study
- Risks: 40% is outside our standard guardrails; puts near-term revenue at risk vs. baseline. Procurement insists on single monthly invoice + SOW.

I've attached: SOW v2, simple pricing comparison vs. our standard packaging, and an exception form with suggested offsets (commitment to auto-scale pricing starting year 2, and a one-time onboarding fee we can invoice).

Request: Marissa/Priyom — approval to proceed with an executive exception (VP/CFO sign-off) for a 40% onboarding discount and bundled seats. If approved, I will send a redline-ready SOW and request a DocuSign link.

Notes for approval:
- Suggested concession guardrails: 6-month check-in with usage milestones, opt-out to revert to standard list pricing at renewal, and a rollback clause if abuse/spike beyond agreed profiles.
- Suggested accounting treatment: recognize monthly committed invoice as deferred revenue, with onboarding fee recognized per accounting guidance (see attached note).

Attachments: strikezone_SOW_v2.pdf, pricing_comparison.xlsx, redwood_exception_form.docx

Thanks — Jordan
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 11:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: StrikeZone strategic onboarding: clearance request (40% off, bundled seats)

Jordan/Priyom —

Appreciate the concise memo. My read: high strategic upside but the 40% hits our margin runway. Before I sign off, I want a succinct mitigation plan that covers:

1) Clear ROI milestones (list 3 measurable adoption KPIs and dates)
2) A cap on token overage pricing (how we bill if they exceed the profile)
3) Commitment language for a renewal price step-up (e.g., year 2 minimum +15% from list)

If you can get procurement to accept the onboarding fee and a committed invoice schedule (monthly, no hourly add-ons), I can consider approval with the following conditions: VP approval of one-off discount tied to legal-approved SOW and finance sign-off on deferred revenue handling.

Please circulate a short one-page exec memo that I can forward to CFO for signature. I want the memo to include the three KPIs and the exact rollback language we will put in the SOW.

—Marissa
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Price <sam.price@strikezone.ai>, Lauren Chen <lauren.chen@strikezone.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: StrikeZone strategic onboarding: clearance request (40% off, bundled seats)

Marissa, Jordan —

I drafted the one-page exec memo as requested and captured the guardrails. See below — I will attach the memo and SOW redline to the DocuSign request once we have verbal sign-off.

--- BEGIN EXEC MEMO ---
To: Marissa Cole (VP) and CFO
From: Priyom Das, Head of Commercial Operations
Re: StrikeZone — Requested onboarding concession (40% off, bundled seats)

Summary: StrikeZone requests an introductory 12-month package at 40% below our hosted list for a 10M tokens/month committed plan plus two bundled seats. They are a strategic prospect in the health analytics vertical with potential to grow usage ~6x in year 2.

Proposed Approval: Grant one-time, VP/CFO exception to approve 40% onboarding discount, subject to the following conditions:
- KPIs (checkpoints at months 1, 3, 6):
  1) Instrumented inference traffic > 2M tokens/month at month 1
  2) Successful ingestion of 3 canonical datasets and two model pipelines in month 3
  3) Production calls >= 5k/day by month 6 (rolling average)
- Billing & inventory: single monthly fixed invoice, onboarding fee $12,000 to offset ramp costs
- Overage & pricing rollback: Overage billed at list price + 10% for any incremental tokens beyond agreed monthly profile; automatic rollback to standard list pricing at renewal unless renewed with executive approval
- Contractual: SOW redline with audit rights, usage reporting cadence, and termination clause for noncompliance
- Finance: Deferred revenue treatment agreed with finance lead (see attached accounting note)

Recommendation: Approve subject to CFO sign-off. If approved, commercial to finalize SOW and issue DocuSign.
--- END EXEC MEMO ---

Marissa — please confirm and I'll route to CFO for signature.

—Priyom
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
